definition.name: Compare one frozen Polly component without executing it

steps.name: Record source and run refusal controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/checkout.txt"
rustc --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/rustc-version.txt"
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
wasm-tools --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/wasm-tools-version.txt"
sha256sum Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml crates/latent-component-threading/Cargo.toml tools/dotnet_frozen_polly_inputs.py tools/dotnet_neutral_stack.py tools/dotnet_neutral_verify.rs tools/compile_dotnet_neutral_verify.py tools/admit_dotnet_neutral_evidence.py tools/tests/test_dotnet_neutral_stack.py tools/guest_emitted_code.py tools/dotnet_guest/internal_io.py > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/source-sha256.txt"
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_neutral_stack -v 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/python-tests.log"

steps.name: Authenticate exact original producer and artifact
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 190s python3 -B tools/dotnet_frozen_polly_inputs.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/acquisition.log"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/acquisition.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original-qualified.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/"

steps.name: Produce and reverse the pinned neutral rewrite
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 180s python3 -B tools/dotnet_neutral_stack.py --original "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm" --derived "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/derivation.json" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/derivation.log"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/"

steps.name: Compile the independent source-bound checker
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 1200s cargo build --locked -p latent-component-threading --lib --message-format=json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/cargo.jsonl" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/cargo.log"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 300s python3 -B tools/compile_dotnet_neutral_verify.py --cargo-messages "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/cargo.jsonl" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/checker" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/checker-compile.log"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/checker/compiler.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/"
cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/checker/tests.log" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/checker-tests.log"

steps.name: Independently compare and validate both components
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
(ulimit -v 524288 && timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 180s "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/checker/checker" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/independent.json") 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/independent.log"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s wasm-tools validate --features all "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s wasm-tools validate --features all "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s wasm-tools component wit "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/original.wit"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s wasm-tools component wit "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/derived.wit"
cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/original.wit" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/derived.wit"
sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/input/original.wasm" "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/work/derived.wasm" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-neutral/observed/component-sha256.txt"

steps.name: Retain only the failed admission marker

reviewReason: Bound one frozen Polly component comparison without enabling a runtime profile.
